requirements.quote: Scope: `bin/lean/prodwatch.mjs` and the CLI `forgedock prod-watch run [--once] [--dry-run] | status`.
Parse `forge.yaml` `prod_watch:` (poll_minutes, sources with flow maps, deployed_probe, governor, target_watch).
Poll loop: sources → triage → governor → file issues with `signal_ref` and the label the `target_watch` (#4765) selects → verify → metrics.
One LLM judgment call per new cluster writes the root-cause hypothesis and issue body, using the repo's conventions. The call goes through injected `io.llm` and counts against the cost cap.
Human-only actions are never taken and are collected into one owner digest per day. P0 incidents page through the repo's declared alert channel; nothing else pages.
Wire `bin/forgedock.mjs` (usage line near the issue-watch entry, known-commands list, dispatch case).

deliverables.change: New module: parseProdWatch (3-level forge.yaml parse reusing parseSources), roundOnce (kill switch, runAdapter, cluster, classifyCluster/parseAlertRules via loadPolicy, validateCluster, admit, one io.llm call per admitted cluster with cost fed to the governor, issue create embedding signalRef + target_watch label, governor summary issue, deployed_probe verify step, computeMetrics/sourceMode/emitMetrics), daily owner digest, P0-incident-only page via io.page, dry-run with zero writes, lock + status.json, prodWatchFromCli(argv, deps) with run [--once] [--dry-run] [--interval] | status. Pure functions, injected io (exec/gh/llm/now/emit/page/fs).

Regression tests with injected io fixtures: config parsing and errors, kill switch no-op, dry-run makes no gh/llm/state writes, signal_ref + label on filed issue, llm cost counted against max_cost_usd_per_round, governor overflow -> one summary, one digest per day, only P0 incident pages, shadow-gated source not filed, status output, CLI arg errors.

Wiring only: usage line next to the issue-watch entry (:3362), 'prod-watch' in the known-commands list (:3949), `case "prod-watch"` dispatching to prodWatchFromCli via dynamic import (like :4210). Under 150 added lines.
New doc: flow, config, kill-switch file, dry-run, owner digest, paging rule, governor mapping, verify step and its limits.
Add a concise `prod_watch` (OPTIONAL) section modelled on the issue_watch section (:627) with a keys table; link PROD-WATCH.md. Keep under 150 added lines.
Add a dossier sentence for bin/lean/prodwatch.mjs next to the prodwatch-governor entry (freshness check).

preserve.what: Exported APIs and behaviour of bin/lean/prodwatch-sources.mjs, prodwatch-triage.mjs, prodwatch-governor.mjs, prodwatch-metrics.mjs (consumed unchanged); read-only contract: only declared list/read/run commands, close only via closeSignal with audit.
bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs and the `issue-watch` CLI case in bin/forgedock.mjs behave as before; core stays repo-agnostic (#1347).
Enumerating tests keep passing without edits: bin/lean/lean.test.mjs, bin/engine/telemetry-seam.test.mjs, bin/lean/{batch,checks,conformance,context,drift,execution,fixround}.test.mjs.

decisions.choice: Parse prod_watch with its own 3-level parser reusing issuewatch's flow-map `scalar` approach instead of parseForgeYaml.
decisions.justification: parseForgeYaml reads one nested level (bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs:40 comment, parseWatches:41); sources are flow maps under prod_watch.sources.<name>.

decisions.choice: Verify step limited to a deterministic deployed_probe check; reopen-on-ineffective not built.
decisions.justification: #4836 (verification loop) is closed as invalid, so no module exists to reuse; the issue scope lists only 'verify' in the loop.

decisions.choice: All logic in new prodwatch.mjs; forgedock.mjs and CONFIG.md get wiring/short section only.
decisions.justification: Hotspot rule: bin/forgedock.mjs 4488 lines, docs/CONFIG.md 2020 lines.
